Cards.Name: Daigotsu Bofana
Cards.Text: After the first time each phase another player's action targets Bofana: If the action was not performed by a card with (current) Force equal to or higher than Bofana's base Force, the player discards a card.

Cards.Name: Daigotsu Bofana
Cards.Text:
After Bofana enters play: Lose 2 Honor and all other players must discard a card, or two cards if they are Crab Clan.
Battle: Target a Dark Virtue in your discard pile: Take an additional action to play it for one of its Battle actions. After it resolves, remove the card from the game.
